name: Gods & Pantheons
body:
Following are a list of deities from various publishers you may want to add to your own home campaign. The god details come from a variety of sources, including Rogue Genius Games and Frog God Games.

Deity	AL	Worshipers/Portfolio	Domains	Symbol	Favored Weapon	Favored Animal	Source
Aleria	LG	Gardeners, healers, lovers	Charm, Good, Healing, Plant	Two meadowlarks, perched together in the silhouette of a heart	Starknife	Meadowlark	PDG:GoP
Arete	LG	Humans and paladins	Good, Law, Protection, War	Blood-red upraised sword on a white background	Longsword or bastard sword	 	FGG:RA
Austri	LG	Dwarves	Artifice, Earth, Good, Strength	Hammer and anvil	Warhammer	 	FGG:RA
Azathoth	CN	Chaos, creation, forces of nature, magic, space, thought	Chaos, Magic, Trickery, Weather, Void	 	Chakram	 	RGG:GitV
Azdan	NE	Extinction, death, genocide, murder, space	Darkness, Death, Evil, Repose, Void	 	Scythe	 	RGG:GitV
Bargrieke	CE	Orcs, half-orcs, some goblins	Death, Destruction, Evil, War	Rotting severed head	Greataxe	 	FGG:RA
Chiuta	N	River and seaside dwellers	Animal, Plant, Repose, Water	Papyrus plant	Sickle	Crocodile	PDG:GoP
Eshsalqua	LE	Entertainers, gangsters, lawyers	Animal, Art, Law, Trickery	A writing quill ending in a grasping hand	Switchblade knife	Mockingbird	PDG:GoP
Ferrakus	N	Earthbound races, miners, stonecrafters	Earth, Fire, Luck, Strength	A mountain with what looks like roots made of magma	Heavy Pick	Mole	PDG:GoP
Fenris Kul	NE	Madmen, suicidal fanatics, terrorists	Destruction, Evil, Strength, Trickery	A flaming knife with two blades.	Battleaxe	Vulture	PDG:GoP
Freya	NG	Human females	Animal, Good, Healing, War	Falcon	Longsword, longbow	Falcon	FGG:RA
Gerana	LG	Honest citizens, knights, rulers	Earth, Glory, Nobility	>A hammer striking an anvil, wreathed by a set of shackles – one open, one closed.	Warhammer	Heavy Warhorse	PDG:GoP
Hecate	LE	Wizards, Women, Assassins, Lawful evil hags, witches, and crones.	Evil, Knowledge, Law, Magic	A half silver disk representing the setting full moon	–	Hell Hound	FGG:RA
Hel	NE	Diseased and disease-causing creatures, evil humanoids, evil druids, women, bards.	Air, Animal, Death, Earth, Fire, Plant, Water	A face, black on one side and white on the other	Poisoned dagger or sword	Vermin	FGG:RA
Helreginn	LG	Humans, Guardians, Paladins, though not currently worshiped.	Good, Healing, Law, Protection	Kite shield of purest white	Shields of all types for shield bash	Hedgehog	FGG:RA
Ilúvatiar	CG	High and wood elves, warriors, wizards and rangers of the elven race.	Animal, Plant, Magic, War	A bow and sword hanging from the eternal oak	Longbow, longsword	 	FGG:RA
Ithreia	LN	Druids, fishermen, hunters	Air, Animal, Water, Weather	An owl made of snowflakes or frosted glass	Pilum	Gyrfalcon, snowy owl, whale	PDG:GoP
Justitia	LN	Barristers, judges, guards, professional soldiers, military officers and nobles.	Healing, Law, Protection, War	A gray shield emblazoned with a stylized black fortress tower	Spear	 	FGG:RA
Kamus	LE	Merchants lords, slavers, xenophobes	Artifice, Law, Sun, Travel	A slave collar encircling a sunburst	Spiked chain	Horse	PDG:GoP
King Gobb	NE	Goblins, hobgoblins, bugbears	Earth, Evil, Magic, Trickery	A crooked-hafted war pick	Heavy Pick	 	FGG:RA
Linium	LN	Craftsmen, lawmakers, wizards	Artifice, Fire, Law, Rune	A pure white disk	Light hammer	Scarlet spider	PDG:GoP
Lyssa	CN	Barbarians, raiders, reavers and plunderers.	Chaos, Destruction, Strength, War	Crossed Sword and Hammer	Greatsword, warhammer	 	FGG:RA
Lyvalia	NE	Bureaucrats, opportunists, politicians	Charm, Knowledge, Nobility, Trickery	A gold coin worn smooth	Fighting fan	Viper	PDG:GoP
Mâl	CE	Apocalyptic cults, evil druids, mâlites	Chaos, Destruction, Evil, Plant	An obsidian rock overgrown with red thorns	Resin blade (scorpion whip)	None	PDG:GoP
Mitra	LG	Paladins, fighters, monks, farmers	Good, Healing, Law, Protection, War	Scales bearing twin flames	Longsword	 	FGG:RA
Myketa	N	Soldiers and their families	Community, Darkness, Time, War	A silhouette of a woman standing in a white rectangle (symbolising an open door)	Longspear	Dog	PDG:GoP
Nemyth Vaar	CN	Fallen knights, mercenaries, outcasts	Chaos, Death, Earth, Madness	A black winged helm with a red left eye glowing within	Bastard sword	Raven	PDG:GoP
Neria	NG	Advisors, musicians, visionaries	Art, Good, Luck, Knowledge	A fortune-telling stone with a two closed, feminine eyes	Sling staff	Wolf	PDG:GoP
Nise	CN	Pirates, sailors, soldiers	Air, War, Water, Weather	Twin swords crossed over a field of lightning.	Cutlass	Seahawk	PDG:GoP
Njord	LN	Farmers and halflings, some druids revering his natural cycle aspect.	Air, Animal, Earth, Fire, Plant, Water	Raining cloud partially obscuring a radiant sun	Sickle	 	FGG:RA
Nyarlathotep	CE	Accidents, destruction, insanity, nightmares, space	Chaos, Destruction, Evil, Madness, Void	 	Dagger	 	RGG:GitV
Orcus	CE	Monsters, undead and evil humanoids	Chaos, Death, Destruction, Evil	Wand of Orcus	Ornamental heavy mace (spiked or skull-tipped)	 	FGG:RA
Paletius	NG	Bards, scholars, wizards	Knowledge, Magic, Rune, Sun	The light of learning; the all-seeing eye; he above	Morningstar	Eagle	PDG:GoP
Ra	NG	Humans	Air, Good, Sun, War	Sun staff (staff with a bronze sphere containing an ankh)	Sun staff, Short sword	 	FGG:RA
Rajuk Amon-Gore	CE	Assassins, doomsayers, necromancers	Art, Chaos, Death, Evil	A star being devoured by a black maw or a black hood with no eyes.	Short sword	Death’s head hawkmoth	PDG:GoP
Rolterra	LE	Rabble-rousers, revolutionaries	Liberation, Magic, Time, Travel	A rusted scythe suspended above wheat fields and a bloody sunrise	Scythe	Barn owl	PDG:GoP
Saren	CG	Druids, foresters, sylvan creatures	Animal, Charm, Chaos, Plant	A rampant (rearing on its hind legs) boar rending a chain with his tusks	Greatclub	Boar	PDG:GoP
Set	LE	Evil power-seeking humanoids, evil monks, assassins	Death, Evil, Knowledge, Law	Black Ankh of Set	Quarterstaff, spear, poisoned weapons	 	FGG:RA
Shade	NE	Assassins, criminals, thieves	Darkness, Death, Luck, Trickery	A burlap sack filled with gold coins and blood	Kukri	Rat	PDG:GoP
Shamash	LN	Justice, life, long journeys, space, the sun and stars	Law, Protection, Sun, Travel, Void	 	Warhammer	 	RGG:GitV
Shankhil	LN	Farmers, judges, morticians	Darkness, Repose, Sun, Weather	A circular gate with an ornate keyhole in the shape of a dagger covering a stylized sun coin	Scizore	Dove	PDG:GoP
The Black One	LE	Assassins, religious scholars	Death, Destruction, Knowledge, Law	A blood-covered woman with four arms wearing a necklace of skulls	Longsword	 	FGG:RA
Thyr	LG	Humans, Royalty	Good, Healing, Knowledge, Law, Protection	Silver cross on a white field	Light or Heavy Mace	 	FGG:RA
Toma Thule	LG	City officials, nobility, paladins	Artifice, Community, Law, Nobility	A golden lions head	Warhammer	Lion	PDG:GoP
Tsathogga	CE	Aberrations, tsathar, sentient frogs, evil water monsters	Chaos, Destruction, Evil, Water	Likeness of the Frog God, carved in soapstone	Any that slash, cut, and are wickedly curved, as well as, ropes or nets	 	FGG:RA
Tulis	CG	Slaves, the oppressed, the poor	Liberation, Nobility, Protection, Strength	A woman half-tied to a stake, her body pierced by a sword – she holds the hilt of the sword in her hand	Longsword	Cattle	PDG:GoP
Ul’ul	CN	Artists, dancers, farmers, madmen	Art, Chaos, Madness, Weather	Swirling random slashes of color	Bladed scarf	Butterfly	PDG:GoP
Veiloaria	NG	Adventurers, innkeepers, travelers	Air, Earth, Travel, Water	A compass adorned with a lotus	Quarterstaff	Common swift	PDG:GoP
Vortain	CE	Addicts, anarchists, drug merchants	Chaos, Madness, Travel, Trickery	A random collage of mix-matched colors	Flail	Hyena	PDG:GoP
Yerran	CN	Rogues, thieves, tricksters	Luck, Trickery,Glory	A jeweled dagger in the center of a gold coin	Dagger	 	PDG:LoY
Yolana	CG	Freedom fighters, historians, spies	Knowledge, Liberation, Protection, Time	A torch laid chained to the center of an open book or a two faced mask, draped in chains.	Sai	Scorpion	PDG:GoP
Egyptian Mythos Gods

Source: Paizo Blog

Here is a preview of the gods of ancient Egypt, their areas of concern, domains, and favored weapons.

Deity	AL	Areas of Concern	Domains	Favored Weapon
Anubis	LN	Burial, the dead, funeral rites, mummification, tombs	Death, Earth, Law, Protection, Repose	Flail
Apep	CE	Chaos, darkness, destruction, snakes	Chaos, Darkness, Destruction, Evil, Scalykind	Dagger
Bastet	CN	Cats, pleasure, secrets	Animal, Chaos, Charm, Protection, Trickery	Cat’s claws (tekko-kagi)
Bes	NG	Households, luck, marriage, protection	Community, Earth, Good, Luck, Protection	Hunga munga
Hathor	CG	Dance, joy, love, music, the sky	Air, Chaos, Charm, Good, Travel	Short sword
Horus	LN	Rulership, the sky, the sun	Air, Animal, Law, Nobility, Sun	Khopesh
Isis	NG	Fertility, magic, motherhood, rebirth	Charm, Community, Good, Healing, Magic	Quarterstaff
Khepri	NG	Freedom, the rising sun, work	Artifice, Good, Liberation, Sun, Trickery	Sling
Maat	LN	Justice, law, order, truth	Knowledge, Law, Protection, Void, Weather	Starknife
Neith	NG	Hunting, war, weaving	Animal, Artifice, Good, War, Water	Shortbow
Nephthys	CN	Mourning, night, protection of the dead	Chaos, Charm, Community, Darkness, Protection	Light mace
Osiris	LG	Afterlife, fertility, rebirth, resurrection	Good, Healing, Law, Plant, Repose	Flail
Ptah	N	Architecture, craftsmanship, creation, metalworking	Artifice, Earth, Fire, Knowledge, Travel	Quarterstaff
Ra	LN	Creation, rulership, the sun	Fire, Glory, Law, Nobility, Sun	Spear
Sekhmet	CN	Fire, healing, vengeance, war	Chaos, Destruction, Fire, Healing, War	Battleaxe
Selket	CG	Embalming, healing, scorpions	Chaos, Good, Healing, Protection, Repose	Scorpion whip
Set	NE	Darkness, deserts, murder, storms	Darkness, Death, Evil, Madness, Weather	Spear
Sobek	CN	Crocodiles, fertility, military prowess, rivers	Chaos, Scalykind, Strength, War, Water	Falchion
Thoth	LN	Magic, the moon, wisdom, writing	Darkness, Knowledge, Law, Magic, Rune	Sickle
Wadjet	LG	Good serpents, the River Sphinx, wisdom	Good, Law, Protection, Travel, Water	Light mace
